<thought>The mass spectrum shows a strong M peak at 276 Da, an M+2 peak at 278 Da with ~33 % of the base intensity, and a noticeable M+1 peak at 277 Da (~16 %). This M+2 intensity matches the characteristic 35Cl/37Cl isotopic pattern (≈3:1), indicating chlorine is present. The sizable M+1 peak is consistent with the cumulative 13C contribution from many carbon atoms, confirming carbon as well. No 1:1 M/M+2 pattern (bromine) or very small M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution are carbon and chlorine. </thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
